sections.title: Guides for the people who bring others together.
sections.lead: Short, practical guides for people who bring others together around an activity: a Sunday run, a long-table dinner, a quiz in a café, a few courts of pickleball. Each guide covers the same four stages: getting ready before the first event, running the night, following up afterwards, and a checklist to finish on.
sections.note: Each one is written for someone running their first few events, but regulars may find a useful idea or two. Where {{brand.name}} can take a job off your hands, the guide says so plainly. Everything else works with or without it.
